description: Generate a structured digest of AI Act regulatory changes since a given date, grouped by severity, in English or German. Useful for weekly compliance reviews or audit prep. Returns Markdown plus event_count (events in the digest) and total_matching. Without a key the digest holds the 10 most severe events.

since.description: ISO 8601 date or timestamp, e.g. "2026-11-01" or "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z". The digest covers everything from this date forward. Required.

topics.description: Restrict digest to these topics. Optional.

name: summarize_changes_since
